LESSON: FUNDAMENTAL PRINCIPLES ,

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Principles of Dharma
Topic 3.1: Fundamental Principles ,

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Fundamental Principles ,
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How can Principles of Dharma be practised in day-to-day life?

2. dramatize the Principles of Dharma in a school environment

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Fundamental Principles ,.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can Principles of Dharma be practised in day-to-day life?
2. Why is it important to live by the Principles of Dharma?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• identify the five selected fundamental Principles of Dharma for character formation
